Website policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated July 28, 2026

Information submitted through this website

When you send a catalog inquiry or request a Rights Gap Analysis, Keyman receives the information you enter, including your name, email address, company or professional name, catalog size, Spotify or Apple Music link, and notes. Do not submit passwords, government identification numbers, banking details, or confidential agreement terms through the website forms.

How the information is used

Submitted information is used to review your request, communicate with you, prepare the requested catalog check, and discuss relevant consulting services. It is not sold to third parties.

Service providers

The website uses Resend to deliver form submissions by email, Google Calendar to provide appointment scheduling, and Apple Music to display embedded track previews. These providers process limited information as needed to operate those services and apply their own privacy terms.

Retention and security

Form submissions are delivered to Keyman’s business email. Reasonable technical measures are used to protect the submission path, but no internet transmission can be guaranteed completely secure. Information is retained only as long as reasonably needed for the inquiry, service relationship, recordkeeping, or legal obligations.

Your choices

You may request access, correction, or deletion of information you submitted, subject to applicable legal and recordkeeping requirements.

Contact

For privacy questions, email admin@keymanpublishing.com.
